chapter: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

quests.title: Special Friends

dialogue.t: "I have neither goals I must reach, nor have I urgent desires. I am a happy shepherd. I care only for alpacas, for the seasons and things that grow, for the cool breeze and rains..."
That's my favorite song. What do you think? Pretty good, huh?
Rawwr!
Roar!
Uhh, are we interrupting its mealtime? It sure looks annoyed...

dialogue.sit: Ah. It's something furry. Something furry is blocking your path...

dialogue.t: Mmm?
Roarrr...
Mmmmm—
Eh? So you're all friends, then?
Rawr! Rawr rawr!

dialogue.sit: Someone who seems in charge of watching the Alpacas comes over and calms the Yumkasaurus...

dialogue.t: Hey, hey, calm yourself, Half-Baked. See, that's why you've got your name, making rash judgments like you always do.
Rawr...

Don't worry about him, he's just got too strong a sense of duty. Gets all antsy when there are strangers about. But it's also thanks to that dedication that I've got an easy time over here taking care of these Alpacas.
Anyway! What brings you people to my little spot?

dialogue.sit: Just roaming about. You know, on our adventures.
I've been considering an idyllic, pastoral life recently...

dialogue.t: Ah, adventurers, then! That said, I imagine Half-Baked saw you as dangerous folks with the scary, scary auras.
Huh. Paimon didn't know that Yumkasaurs could do that. And here we were thinking the Alpacas were about to get attacked! Guess it was all just a misunderstanding, huh?
Aye, and a common one it is, too. I know my fella looks fierce, but he's pretty close to yon' Alpacas. Why, I'd even call them friends!
Rrrooo... Rawr! Rawr! Raaawr!
Hmm? What's up, little guy? You wanna be friends with them too?
Rawr! Raaaawrrr!
Wow, guess so. But yeah, thinking about it, you usually just hang out with the two of us. Some animal friends...

That would do 'im good, yes. Would be quite the adorable scene, too, don't you think — a lil' Tepetlisaur surrounded by Alpaca friends? Me, I could chow down on three bowls of Blazed Meat Stew before I got bored of it.
Still, that'll depend on whether my Alpacas agree or not. Friendship's not to be forced, and all. Wouldn't you say so, Half-Baked?
Mrrmph.

dialogue.sit: Oho, what's this? Someone doesn't wanna get friendly with our {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?
It's alright. Whatever happens, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s still got us.

dialogue.t: Hey, hey, no need to get all defensive! Let's just give {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} a chance to try this out for himself.
Kids only grow when they learn how to get by through their own hard work, right?
Rawr!
Well, your Tepetlisaur's got confidence coming out of its ears, or I'm blind. Guess I'll head back and get some rest. Just holler if there's trouble...
Wait, you know what? Might as well holler for Half-Baked instead. He's the Alpaca expert here, after all... Just kidding. Alright, little fella, you've got this. Good luck!
Roar!
Roooah... Rawr?
Mmmmm—
Wooo... Rrrooo...
Uh... Is this one holding a grudge because of our misunderstanding with Half-Baked?
Oh well, not much we can do about that now. C'mon, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. Let's try our luck elsewhere!
(Looks like it's still mad at us...)
...Mmm?
Rawr!
Roar...? Rawr! Raaawr!
...Mmmm?
Rawr!
Rroo...

dialogue.sit: Doesn't look like there's much hope here...

dialogue.t: Well, uh, these things happen, you know? Don't feel down, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. You've still got a chance!
Rawr!
Mmmmm—
Roooah... Ooroo...
Oh boy, looks like we interrupted a feeding session... Don't worry, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}. This was just bad timing, that's all! Let's try our luck elsewhere.
Mmmmm—
Rawr!
Mmm...
Huh? What's this other Alpaca doing here?
Rawr! Rawr rawr!
What's wrong. Is it trapped down there?
(It looks terrified...)
One, two, three, four.
Four... It's hiding again. Where has it gone?
Rawr!

dialogue.sit: Only after much "Rawr! Rawr!"-ing encouragement from {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} does the timid Alpaca climb back up using the freshly-laid wood plank path...

dialogue.t: Moo... Mmmmoo—
Oroo? Rawr! Raaawr!

dialogue.sit: Faced with {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s enthusiasm, the timid-looking Alpaca seems unafraid, instead bending down and gently touching {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} with its nose...

dialogue.t: Roooah... Rawr!
Hehe! Guess that means you're getting on great, huh?

dialogue.sit: A friend of yours, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, is a friend of mine.

dialogue.t: And Paimon's too... Wait, when did this become a competition?
Still, it's kinda dangerous for this Alpaca to be out here completely on its own. We'd better go tell Wactana what's going on.
Also, Paimon's sure she'll be happy to hear that {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s made a friend, too!
(Doesn't look quite so scared anymore...)
I see you're back, little fella. How did it go? Make any Alpaca friends?
Rawr! Rawr rawr!
Haha, aren't you a happy camper? Why, you're even making me feel all jolly!
Hey, Wactana, shouldn't you be a bit more concerned about what happens to the Alpacas? The one {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} made friends with was in a real tight spot back there.
That so? Guess I gotta talk to Half-Baked real quick then, tell it to take more care.

dialogue.sit: You're way too chill about this.

dialogue.t: I mean, I am living the dream! C'mon, be happy for me and stuff!
Ah, yes. If {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s fond of the Alpaca toy over by the side, I can let y'all have it.
Rawwr!
Guess {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} doesn't know what "standing on ceremony" is, huh. Thanks then, Wactana!
Eh, no biggie. And if you wanna drop by again, you're always welcome.

quests.description: Your Saurian buddy wants to make some new friends…
